steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each fee is matched to the fee card, and each term to the standard terms.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 fee differs from the card with no approval

findings.title: Fee differs from the card with no approval
findings.fix: Get the approval or restore the card fee

findings.title: Scope item with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the scope item

findings.title: Term not in the standard terms
findings.fix: Take the term to the firm's counsel

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

[high] scope-item-1.md:12  Fee differs from the card with no approval.
       Fix: Get the approval or restore the card fee.
[medium] scope-item-2.md:19  Scope item with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the scope item.
[low] discount.md:26  Term not in the standard terms.

Not checked: Whether the client accepts.
pros: Checks a fee that differs from the card with no approval, a scope item with no source, and a term not in the standard terms.
cons: Not checked: Whether the client accepts.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-proposal-hr-consulting skill on the records for this review.
